# settings

Settings dialog and the prefs it edits.

- Spec: `docs/features/settings/spec.md`
- Contract: `docs/features/settings/contract.md`

## Files

```
go: internal/server/prefs*.go
web: web/src/features/settings.ts
web: web/src/render/settings*.ts
```

## Protocol

- `prefs.put` — `PUT /api/prefs`

## Decisions

- `kb:adr/rail-activity-line-turn-aware-default-with-pref` — The activity line is turn-aware by default — your prompt while a turn is open, Claude's reply once it closes — with a pref for prompt, reply or both. (accepted, 2026-09-22; features: rail, settings, lifecycle) → `docs/adr/rail-activity-line-turn-aware-default-with-pref.md`
- `kb:adr/rail-card-title-leads-and-density-ramp-corrected` — The rail card leads with its wrapping title and puts the state row beneath it; the density ramp grows monotonically from compact to expanded. (accepted, 2026-09-22; features: rail, settings) → `docs/adr/rail-card-title-leads-and-density-ramp-corrected.md`
- `kb:adr/rail-user-owned-manual-order-default` — The rail has two sort modes: manual, the default, keeps a user-owned pinned-then-positional order; attention is the old needs-input-first sort, kept as a mode. (accepted, 2026-08-30; features: rail, settings) → `docs/adr/rail-user-owned-manual-order-default.md`
- `kb:adr/theme-pref-enum-follow-not-nullable` — The theme pref is an enum with a follow default, not a nullable; the daemon validates a pattern and treats the value as opaque, the client owns the registry. (accepted, 2026-09-02; features: theme, settings) → `docs/adr/theme-pref-enum-follow-not-nullable.md`
- `kb:adr/theme-pref-follows-claude-until-picked` — A Settings dialog offers Follow Claude Code, Instrument, Dark and Light as a theme pref; until the user picks, the dashboard follows Claude Code's family. (accepted, 2026-09-02; features: theme, settings) → `docs/adr/theme-pref-follows-claude-until-picked.md`
- `kb:adr/update-check-pref-governs-automatic-checking-only` — The update-check pref governs the daemon's automatic schedule only; a user-initiated check always runs, and canCheck says when one is possible. (accepted, 2026-09-22; features: update, settings) → `docs/adr/update-check-pref-governs-automatic-checking-only.md`
- `kb:adr/usage-masthead-one-selectable-model-window` — The wire carries every model-scoped weekly window; the masthead shows one, chosen by a selector and persisted as a preference with a default model. (accepted, 2026-08-30; features: usage, settings) → `docs/adr/usage-masthead-one-selectable-model-window.md`

## Retired, rejected and superseded

- `kb:adr/nongoal-ui-scaling-delegated-to-browser-zoom` — No in-app text-size or UI-size control; browser zoom is the scaling mechanism, and the deferred textSize pref is retired rather than built. (rejected, 2026-09-13; features: theme, settings) → `docs/adr/nongoal-ui-scaling-delegated-to-browser-zoom.md`
- `kb:adr/rail-card-state-row-then-wrapping-title` — The rail card leads with a small state row and lets the title wrap; a three-step density pref in the rail head trades rows for cards. (superseded, 2026-09-22; features: rail, settings) → `docs/adr/rail-card-state-row-then-wrapping-title.md`
- `kb:adr/update-check-pref-governs-checking-only` — One boolean pref, default on, governs only whether the daemon checks for a newer release; applying is always explicit via a button or the update flag. (superseded, 2026-09-10; features: update, settings) → `docs/adr/update-check-pref-governs-checking-only.md`
